name: Pricing builder: JPY rejects decimals, a custom price flows into the simulator
description: FR1. Builder validation and the hand-off of a custom catalog to the simulator.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, click 'Builder' in the top navigation bar, then click 'Reset to reference catalog'
Assert the text 'Catalog is valid: 10 prices, 4 coupons, 2 tax rates.' is shown
In the first price row, change Currency to JPY and set Amount to 29.5
Assert an alert reads 'starter_m: JPY has no minor unit, so the amount cannot have decimals'
Set the first price's Amount to 4500 and its Price id to starter_jpy, then click 'Simulate with this catalog'
Assert the simulator shows the custom catalog banner, no 'Load scenario' dropdown, and Invoice 1 total ¥4,500
